'''Shabell''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] tried to take a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] into [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s war room, she detected and deactivated the device using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="The Courtship of Princess Leia" />

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], Shabell became a member of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] sect led by [[Gethzerion]]. Having fallen under the influence of the dark side, she lived among the Nightsisters and served their matriarch in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Shabell was among the witches who retrieved [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] after he surrendered himself to the Nightsisters; transporting him aboard a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] skiff to their leader. During the encounter, Shabell sensed that Solo was concealing an explosive device on his person and quietly neutralized the threat using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], though Solo himself believed the device had gone undetected.<ref name="The Courtship of Princess Leia" />
